text:
The best choice depends on whether you want a big party speaker or one you can toss in a beach bag. All of these handle water exposure. Rinse any of them with fresh water after salt or chlorine, since IP ratings don't cover corrosion ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)).

## Top picks

**1. JBL Charge 6: best all-around (~$130–$160)**
- **Rating:** IP68 (dust-tight, survives submersion).
- **Battery:** 20 hours, or 28 with Playtime Boost.
- **Power:** 40W, and it can charge your phone.
- **Reviews:** What Hi-Fi's best overall, BestProducts' best overall, and iTechGuides' top beach/pool pick.
- **Price:** About $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon (per What Hi-Fi), or $150 on sale from $200 (per BestProducts).
- **Buy:** Use the retailer links on [What Hi-Fi's list](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) or [BestProducts' list](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/).

**2. Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM: best for 360° pool sound**
- **Rating:** IP67, and it floats.
- **Sound:** 360° design, so it sounds the same wherever people sit or swim.
- **Battery:** About 15 hours.
- **Reviews:** Tom's Guide's best overall and RTINGS' best mid-range pick.
- **Buy:** Use the retailer links on [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) or [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth).

**3. JBL Boombox 4: best for big pool parties (splurge)**
- **Water:** Handles long immersion and floats.
- **Battery:** Over 40 hours.
- **Sound:** Loud, balanced output. It can sound muffled from the sides or behind.
- **Downside:** It's big and heavy.
- **Reviews:** RTINGS' #1 waterproof speaker.
- **Buy:** RTINGS links to Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart from its [page](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth).

**4. Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4: best budget (~$65–$80)**
- **Size:** Softball-sized.
- **Rating:** IP67, and it floats.
- **Battery:** 13–14 hours.
- **Sound:** Bigger than you'd expect for the size.
- **Downside:** No app.
- **Buy:** Use the retailer links on [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/), which listed it at $65.

**5. JBL Grip: best ultra-portable beach speaker (~$100)**
- **Size:** Can-shaped and under 1 lb.
- **Rating:** IP68.
- **Battery:** 12 hours.
- **Reviews:** Good Housekeeping's best overall for beach trips.
- **Buy:** Use the retailer links on [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/).

**Also worth a look: soundcore Boom 2 Plus (~$200 with code)**
- **Power:** 100W (140W with BassUp).
- **Water:** IPX7, and it floats.
- **Battery:** 20 hours at half volume. It can charge your phone.
- **Price:** $249.99. Dealectric reports that code **AFSC20** took $49.99 off in a cart test on 2026-10-22. The code doesn't work on items already on sale.
- **Caveats:** It's heavy at 3.8 kg. The "X" in IPX7 means it has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach.
- **Buy:** [Buy via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission. ([source](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus))

## Quick verdict
- **Most people:** JBL Charge 6.
- **Floating 360° pool sound:** UE EPICBOOM.
- **Big parties:** JBL Boombox 4.
- **Budget or carry-anywhere:** WONDERBOOM 4 or JBL Grip.

I only had review pages for the JBL and UE speakers, not direct product links, which is why those links go to the reviews. Check the current price at checkout.
